description: This file is a C++ header defining a test fixture class for SharedMemoryBuffer, including constants, class declaration, and method prototypes for testing shared memory buffer functionalities in a media server context.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing SharedMemoryBuffer functionalities, providing setup, teardown, and various test methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with specified maximum playbacks and web audio players.

methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.description: Tests that mapping a partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a partition with given playback type and ID fails.
